en: Sepia-toned panoramic photograph mounted on a card, showing a large complex of long, low, stone barracks buildings surrounded by walls and dirt roads. The foreground features open, slightly hilly ground with stones, while in the distance there is a town with scattered houses and a church or clock tower, backed by low hills. At the bottom center of the card, a slip of paper bears a typed or printed title in Cyrillic.
